topic: The 4-part structure of a high-converting LinkedIn hook
hook: Your hook determines 80% of your post's reach. Here is the framework:
body:
1. The Pattern Interrupt: State a counter-intuitive observation
2. The Stakes: Clarify why ignoring this costs time or revenue
3. The Bridge: Transition to your methodology
4. The Proof: Specific verifiable result

Test your next post with this structure and watch the read-through rate climb.
